titles.romaji: The Naked King: Utsukushiki Waga Jinsei wo
titles.english: The Naked King 〜What a Beautiful Life〜
titles.native: The Naked King 〜美しき我が人生を〜

description:
A short film (music video) directed and animated by Rapparu for the song The Naked King by BIGMAMA.

Note: There exists two versions of this song; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on May 25, 2021 and a fully-English version of the song also by BIGMAMA, which was uploaded on June 2, 2021.
